desc: The Dash, the Boki base's first minigame (briefs/design/GARDEN.md 5.1, scripts/home/base_race.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. 2 to 4 Boki run one lap of a short loop next to the Training post; you back your partner and cheer with the training drill's timing bar at three marks. Units: metres, seconds, metres a second; joy and trust are 0-100 points, bonds -1..1.

bramblebank.name: Hedge lane
bramblebank.note: A winding lane along the berry hedge: ford the brook, climb the bank, hop the log.

glasswater.name: Pond loop
glasswater.note: Along the shore, across the channel on stepping stones, back wading the shallows, up the bank to the line.

cinderstep.name: Hill climb
cinderstep.note: A run-up, a switchback up the terrace, a leap over a crack at the top, a quick slope down.

hushwood.name: Wood path
hushwood.note: A path that winds between the trunks, up a root hill, through the brook, over a fallen log.

ridge.name: Ridge track
ridge.note: Up the ridge stair, along the top, a gust gap, and a long run down the far side.

courses_doc: One course per garden zone (garden_zones.json ids; a zone with none, the hub, runs bramblebank's), our own layouts: four stretches in order, each a kind (straight, water, climb, jump), a 'mult' (everyone's pace on it: swimming and climbing are slow, a slope down is quick) and 'pts', metres right (x) and up the screen (-z) of the start line, the points after the end of the stretch before it. The first stretch starts at [0, 0] and the last ends there, so the lap is closed; each stretch's length is worked out from its points. The three marks are the ends of the first three stretches.
posts_doc: Where the race post stands in a zone (GardenZones.here), tiles x and z; the line is LOOP_OFF from it and the course (above) runs from there. It needs no Training post, and the zone's scatter keeps clear of the loop. The start zone's post stands by the farm's Training post.
max_turn_doc: Degrees a course may turn at one point inside the lap (not at the line, where the lap ends and starts); --race-check measures every course. The switchback up Cinderstep is the sharpest.
lap_band_doc: s: a Boki with no Speed points at joy 50 and no lean runs any zone's lap in this time (--race-check). The faster or slower the Boki, the further from it.
pace_doc: m/s on a straight for a Boki with no Speed points and joy 50.
speed_per_point_doc: Each trained Speed point (Care stats) adds this much pace, as a fraction.
mood_doc: Pace multiplier at joy 0 and at joy 100 (linear in between): a glum Boki drags its feet.
swim_per_tide_doc: The water stretch: +this fraction of pace per level of the Tide knack (Work, 1-4). A Boki's rec['lean']['water'] (GARDEN 9.1, 0..1) counts as 4 levels at 1.0 once leans exist.
glide_doc: The jump stretch: a winged species (its look has wings) glides the gap at this times the pace; rec['lean']['flying'] blends toward it.
wobble_doc: Each stretch every runner's pace is rolled within +-this fraction, so the fastest Boki is likely, not certain, to win.
cheer_doc: Your backed Boki's pace on the next stretch after each mark's press.
bonds_doc: rec['bonds'][uid] at or above friend_at: friends; at or below rival_at: rivals.
friend_doc: Friends within friend_near m of each other run side by side: each one's pace moves this fraction of the way to the other's.
bump_doc: Rivals within bump_near m bump once a stretch: both run at bump_slow times the pace for bump_s seconds.
energy_doc: A Boki needs min_energy to race and spends this much running.
gems_doc: Gems to you when your backed Boki wins, or for any other race.
result_doc: The last one home and the winner grow apart by rival_step; two non-rivals home within close_s of each other grow closer by friend_step.
train_doc: The Training post's solo lap (base_race.gd solo): Speed points per cheer grade (a miss is 0), +dojo per cheer that was not a miss with a Dojo built, x happy_mult at joy >= happy_at; the Boki needs min_food Full to start and spends food and the race's energy; joy moves by joy_great with any great cheer, else joy_else. Capped by level (Care.stat_cap).

twists.name: High tide
twists.note: The water runs deep and slow

twists_doc: The weekly event: one format a week, picked by the real week number (unix days / 7) mod the list, no server, shown on the race post and pinned with the winner's photo to the showcase wall. 'game' is the minigame it tweaks (dash, seek, volley); other games play as usual that week. Tweaks: 'mult' multiplies everyone's Dash pace on that stretch kind; 'wobble' replaces the Dash wobble; 'swap' {at, kind, mult} changes one Dash stretch; 'night' forces the Seek's night rule; 'to_win' replaces the Volley's points to win.
card_s_doc: s the result card stays up.
